profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I’m a creative problem solver first and foremost. I thrive on evaluating what’s broken and rebuilding it with a clear vision in mind. Whether I’m architecting a complex system of applications, envisioning a new feature, or presenting a product to stakeholders, I strive for more than a working solution. My goal is to get things done quickly and accurately while ensuring all parties are on the same page.

My unique background in project management and communications has strengthened the foundation for my software engineering career in many ways. After all, how many SWEs can say they enjoy writing documentation? The skills and perspectives gained through my previous experience have helped me collaborate across technical and non-technical teams with ease, even as scope, timeline, or requirements change.

However, my skills as a software engineer go beyond communications. I have proven myself as a critical thinker through self-driven projects in and out of the workplace. I think about problems not only in terms of immediate requirements, but long-term needs and high-level impact, too. Where possible, I consider all of these factors and weigh options to find the solution which sets us up for the greatest success. This approach has helped me earn my M.S. in Software Engineering with a focus on domain-driven design.

Aside from my analysis skills, I also have a lifelong love of learning, which has aided me in learning multiple tech stacks in a short time. I do my best work when I’m hands-on in a system with a goal in mind. By utilizing this learning method, I have successfully contributed to two distinct teams (each with their own stacks and areas of focus). I have also accelerated through both my M.S. and B.S., earning my degrees in a cumulative nine months. Though it took a ton of dedication and perseverance, I am proud of my accomplishments and the effort it took to achieve them.

In the future, I would love to continue helping businesses improve their systems, whether as an individual contributor or a software architect. If you also consider yourself a creative problem-solver in the tech space, I encourage you to connect with me! I am always happy to expand my network and welcome anyone who would like to help each other achieve our professional goals.

positions.title: Marketing Project Manager
positions.description:
Formulated and facilitated comprehensive digital communications strategies, propelling managed locations to achieve top sales among all new Amazing Lash Studio locations nationwide.
Conducted training sessions for new team members on project guidelines and procedures, ensuring a smooth transition of responsibilities for new and departing team members.
Coordinated the collaborative development of communications and advertising materials across multiple teams, ensuring seamless integration of messaging and brand consistency.
Managed all client communications, including meticulous product proofing, facilitation of weekly client meetings, and regular updates on innovative marketing strategies.

positions.title: Communications Coordinator
positions.description:
Played an instrumental role in creating impactful internal and external communications materials for the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs Suicide Prevention Program.
Orchestrated high-profile VA communications events, including the 2021 Suicide Prevention Month Radio Media Tours (reaching over 8 million listeners) and the 2022 Grants Webinar Series (which garnered White House attention).
Served as the primary point of contact for project-specific communication with VA leadership, ensuring effective coordination and streamlined workflows.

positions.title: Onboarding Specialist
positions.description:
Created websites and social media profiles to clients' specifications, targeting their SEO keyword(s) and interests.
Led introductory client calls and mentored digital account managers on best practices for client communication.
Assisted with client handoff, including introduction to digital account manager, month 1 reporting, and de-escalation of client concerns.

positions.title: Digital Account Manager
positions.description:
Implemented and managed concurrent SEO strategies for up to 25 clients, resulting in improved visibility for each client's primary search term and a significant rise in client satisfaction ratings.
Generated detailed monthly reports for clients and conducted strategic sessions as required, fostering strong partnerships and aligning goals for optimal outcomes.

positions.title: Assistant Manager
positions.description:
Led and mentored a team of three SEO account managers, devising personalized professional development plans which resulted in two staff promotions.
Continued Digital Account Manager duties.
